scientific_integrity: Exact depthwise rational ranks follow from a proof using Hensel roots and rational affine rigidity; independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires rational irreducibility, monicity and complete squarefree splitting modulo p; no result for ramification or reducible polynomials. Finite sample ranks do not prove the infinite theorem. Qualitative nonregularity is known from Bell (2007). Historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact finite-depth \(p\)-kernel ranks for valuations of totally split irreducible polynomials
